results.missing_scope: counter gaps between first/last observed payload only; unknown leading/trailing losses are not estimated

diagnostic_observation.method: previous-state hold between observed 100ms diagnostics; gaps included

results.resource_scope: simulator, bridge and their supervised children; excludes test observer and packet capture

measurement_window.scope: source-fenced and drained checkpoint deltas; no startup/diagnostic tail; SRT gap is not automatically WAN loss

gap_attribution.scope: cumulative snapshots have different startup/tail boundaries; stage counts are not an exact conservation equation

command_summary.scope: local Execute invocation to terminal status observation; includes up to 200ms status polling; unresolved attempts excluded and counted separately

robot.scope: process CPU deltas between observations; startup/exit tails unobserved; RSS sum can double-count shared pages
